runs.note: Fourteen small models on a 12 GB RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, three trials of every scenario in core, productivity, developer and complex-work: 1,806 attempts, 848 passes, 952 model failures and 6 infrastructure exclusions (four daemon crashes, two unavailable sandboxes). Run serially from a checkout at 92437e37 whose daemon and packages were last built from 7e7fb07c, one commit earlier, with native 0.1.62 and task strategy auto, which is outcome without the recipe; books without a contract run stepwise. Every model ran entirely on the GPU except Granite 4.2 8B: at its catalog 64K context with f16 KV it needs about 15 GiB, so llama.cpp placed layers on the CPU in all 129 trials, it decoded 4.11–19.76 tokens/s, and 50 of its 78 failures were attempts stopped for lack of progress or by the time limit, so its results are probably understated. Nanbeige 4.2 3B was left out for the same reason. GPU power changed during the run, so measurement periods are kept separate: the three Gemma models and the first 21 Qwen 3.5 9B core trials ran under a 45 W limit, the rest at about 77 W, and five Nemotron productivity trials overlapped 22 minutes on battery. Cells first measured during Windows Modern Standby, and one cell interrupted by a power loss, were discarded and rerun; no published trial overlaps standby. Claude Sonnet 5.5 reviewed the 724 judgeable trials that produced a deliverable afterward, through the Claude CLI; 74 produced none. Reviews are advisory and kept separate by rubric. The download has every trial's review, speeds, memory, engine record and evidence hashes.
